title: Menna Bishop
text:
I am a PhD Candidate in Economics at the University of Warwick.
I am also an Affiliated Scholar at the Data, Policy and Innovation Centre, a partnership between the Government of Odisha and the University of Chicago Trust.
My research is in Development and Environmental Economics.
You can find my recent work on the research page and download my CV.
My email is menna[dot]bishop[at]warwick.ac.uk.
